summary: The implementation addresses most requirements with periodic polling, IC canister storage with chunking, file preview functionality, and storage quota tracking. However, some acceptance criteria are partially implemented or missing: inactive polling pause (REQ-1), syntax highlighting for text files (REQ-4), zoom/pan controls for images (REQ-4), and configurable admin polling interval (REQ-5).

missing_requirements.requirement: Polling can be paused when user is inactive to save resources
missing_requirements.reason: The useListFiles hook implements refetchInterval: 3000 for automatic polling, but there is no mechanism to detect user inactivity and pause polling. The polling runs continuously regardless of user activity.

missing_requirements.requirement: TXT files display content with syntax highlighting if applicable
missing_requirements.reason: FilePreview.tsx displays text content in a ScrollArea but does not implement syntax highlighting. The text is rendered as plain text without any code highlighting for formats like JS, TS, JSON, etc.

missing_requirements.requirement: Images render in an image viewer with zoom and pan controls
missing_requirements.reason: FilePreview.tsx renders images using a simple img tag without zoom or pan functionality. The preview shows images but lacks interactive controls for zooming and panning.

missing_requirements.requirement: Polling interval is configurable and can be adjusted based on admin preferences
missing_requirements.reason: The ActivityFeed component uses useActivityFeed hook with hardcoded polling, but there is no UI or mechanism for admins to configure or adjust the polling interval dynamically.

hallucinated_features.description: Profile setup and user profile management system with name and email fields
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest does not mention user profiles, profile setup flow, or storing user name/email. The implementation adds ProfileSetup component, UserProfile type, and associated backend methods not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Authorization and access control system with roles and permissions
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest does not specify user roles, admin roles, or permission systems. The implementation includes AccessControl module, role checking, and permission-based access not in requirements.

hallucinated_features.description: Search functionality in header with search input field
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest does not mention search capability for files. Header component includes a search input with Search icon that was not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Grid and list view modes for file display with toggle buttons
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest does not specify different view modes for file listings. FileList component implements view mode switching between grid and list layouts not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Theme switching between dark and light modes
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest does not mention theming or dark mode functionality. Implementation includes ThemeProvider, theme toggle button, and dark/light theme styles.
